patches.summary: Pre-launch build reported ahead of release. No official patch notes were reported for it.
Second pre-launch build, reported a few days before release. No official patch notes were reported for it.
The first update after launch. Outlets report fixes for crashes and several gameplay bugs. Check the publisher's support page for its own list.
highlights: Fixes an issue that stopped players from losing their Wanted Level

articles.title: GTA VI is out on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
articles.summary: Outlets report the game launched on 19 November 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. We have no verified PC release date yet.

articles.title: First post-launch update, 01.002.002, is rolling out
articles.summary: A small update landed on 23 November with crash and bug fixes. Download sizes are reported as roughly 604 MB on PS5 and 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X|S.
